description: The mariadb spec leaves these fields as plain strings. `uri` on Credentials and CredentialsResponse is the connection URI holding the password: STACKIT's Terraform provider marks it Sensitive (stackit/internal/services/mariadb/credential/resource.go, read 2026-11-01). `encryption_key` on the backups config is, by its name, the key that encrypts backups. `metrics_prefix` on InstanceParameters: the spec's own description says it may hold an API key. No live probe: no credentials exist for this account.
